Spiderman Wandkunst

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1884108-spiderman-wall-art#profileId-2017733

Minimalist Spider-inspired mask for clean setups. Multi-color ready via AMS; No supports, fast print, slick top finish with ironing. Looks crisp on a black backer.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.12mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.12 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#000000), PLA (#C12E1F), PLA (#FFFFFF)
